name: Messenger to Darkshire
summary: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon sends an urgent plea to Darkshire for aid. Blackrock orcs and gnolls threaten Redridge, and Solomon turns to his neighbor for military support. A courier must cross Duskwood's shadowed roads to deliver the letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire's mayor.

sections.title: A Desperate Call for Aid
sections.body: Redridge faces growing pressure from Blackrock orcs and gnoll packs, and Lakeshire's guards are stretched thin. Stormwind's royal court has ignored Magistrate Solomon's pleas, while Westfall is caught up in its own insurrection. With little help nearby, Solomon writes to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke in Duskwood, hoping Darkshire can lend or hire its Night Watch to strengthen Lakeshire's defenses.

sections.title: The Road into the Gloom
sections.body: Solomon's letter must travel south through Duskwood, a forest under supernatural gloom. He warns you to keep to the roads, since the wilderness between Lakeshire and Darkshire is perilous. The letter is bound for Town Hall, where Lord Ebonlocke can receive it. Whether Duskwood can spare any forces is another matter.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire asking Darkshire for help?
faq.answer: Stormwind has withheld formal military aid, leaving Lakeshire to face threats such as the Blackrock orcs alone. Magistrate Solomon is asking nearby allies for help and hopes Darkshire's Night Watch can lend trained fighters.

Lord Ello Ebonlocke is Darkshire's mayor and a prominent civilian leader in Duskwood. He oversees the town from Town Hall and coordinates civic affairs with Commander Althea Ebonlocke, who leads the Night Watch.
The Night Watch is Darkshire's independent civilian militia. Without Stormwind garrison troops, it patrols the town's perimeter and fights undead, beasts, and shadows in Duskwood.

faq.q: Why does Solomon warn me to stay on the roads?
faq.answer: Duskwood's wilderness holds undead horrors, spiders, and feral beasts. Leaving the paved road puts you within reach of predators and ambushes.
Magistrate Solomon's series of urgent letters began with his plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall. He is continuing his effort to find help for Lakeshire.

faq.q: Does Darkshire actually have guards to spare?
faq.answer: Duskwood faces its own crisis, with risen dead, rogue worgen, and lurking monstrosities. The Night Watch has barely enough fighters to defend Darkshire, so Solomon's plea is a long shot.

angles.text: Solomon's urgent letters show how neglected the outlying Alliance towns have become while Stormwind's royal court remains paralyzed.
As a human, you share the plight of southern human settlements, which rely on local militias after the kingdom withdrew its regular army patrols.
